Name: WZT-3M
Notes: 204 on order. Initial orders were of Polish-made units before being licence-produced by Bharat Earth Movers Limited.

Name: Armoured Vehicle Tracked Light Repair (AVLTR)
Notes: Based on BMP-2 with turret removed and bulldozer blade and other engineering equipment added. Being manufactured at Ordnance Factory Medak.

Name: Armoured Engineer Reconnaissance Vehicle
Notes: Status: In service. 53 on order. BMP-2 based engineering and reconnaissance vehicle (Armoured Engineer Reconnaissance Vehicle) being manufactured at Ordnance Factory Medak.

Name: Mechanical Minefield Marking Equipment Mk-II
Notes: Status: In service since August 2025. Developed by DRDO's R&DE(E), manufactured by BEML and deployed by the Corps of Engineers.

Name: Bridge Laying Tank T-72
Notes: Status: On order. 47 ordered for ₹1,561 crore (US$160 million) on 21 Jan 2025. T-72 M1 tank variant integrated with long Military Load Classification 70 bridge, can be used to cross canal/stream/river by all tracked & wheeled vehicles in service with the Army.

Name: Arjun BLT
Notes: BLT Arjun is a fast and reliable bridge laying system built on the Main Battle Tank Arjun, it is capable of launching a 24 m bridge with in 10 minutes on any wet and dry obstacles, facilitating speedy induction.

Notes: Status: In Service. 41 sets on order. Developed and designed by DRDO. Manufactured by L&T. 46 m mobile bridging system. Each sets consists of "7 carrier vehicles based on 8×8 HMVs and 2 launcher vehicles based on 10×10 HMVs.

Name: Axiscades Tank Transporter Trailer
Notes: Status: On order. An order for 212 units placed with Axiscades Aerospace and Technologies Pvt Ltd on August 1, 2025 at a cost of ₹223.95 crore. It can carry 50-ton tanks and other armoured vehicles and is equipped with hydraulic & pneumatic loading ramps, steerable and liftable axles.

Name: CL 70 Mat Ground Surfacing
Notes: Mounted on Tatra vehicle with automated laying and recovery has been developed for providing mobility in sandy and marshy terrain.
